per_share_source: Per-share distribution of each of the nine, from the custodian's own rows only (tx_cache; no close and no Yahoo number enters the amount). Source rows: Transaction_Type dv, dvlt, dvst (dollar Amount, no Quantity except 55 dvlt rows that carry the shares paid on) for the nine CUSIPs: 1591 account-date rows after summing same-day rows (from 1,783 transaction rows: 1,613 dv and 170 dvlt; 0 dvst). Per-share = Amount / the account's share balance just BEFORE the row's date, the balance built by cumulating the account's signed Quantity over all its rows for the CUSIP (signs from commonwealth_signs.SIGN; QA/CAF/CAE carry their own sign; rows on the same date are excluded from the balance). Check: on the 55 dvlt rows that carry shares paid on, the balance equals that Quantity within 1 percent on 55 of 55. Rows with a balance <= 0: 8 dropped. Events: account-date rows within 3 calendar days of each other make one event; per event the per-share amount is the median over accounts; a row more than 20 percent from the median is dropped (0 dropped); rows kept 1583, in 229 events (100 events rest on a single account, 129 on two or more accounts, whose per-share amounts agree within a maximum spread of 0.12 percent of the median). dvr reinvestment rows (1,121 rows, which give the price on the reinvest date, Amount/Quantity) are not added as distributions: 964 dvr account-date rows each sit within 5 days of a same-account dv/dvlt row and are that distribution's reinvestment; 0 dvr rows stood alone. The price before each distribution (P) is the dvr NAV on the event date plus the per-share amount on 199 events, the cached Yahoo Close of the previous day on 4, and unavailable on 26 (all before the cache starts, 2020-06-29, and before every pair). Implied factor at a date t = product over events after t of (1 - per-share / P). The Yahoo cache holds no dividend column (columns: date, Close, Adj Close); its own dividend steps are read as Adj Close/Close changes of more than 0.05 percent between consecutive days. Independent check of the derived amounts: the custodian-implied factor, rescaled to 1 at the fund's last custodian event, against the same factor read from Yahoo's Adj Close/Close at the pair dates: correlation 0.9999 or better for 8 of 9 funds (FINFX 0.913, whose first pair lies in a stretch with no custodian distribution), within 2 percent on 103 of 104 pairs.

table.test_rule: Per left-on-store security: the build's silver-store rows on days the store labels yahoo_finance, matched to the cached Yahoo Close and Adj Close on the same date (at least 20 days). UNTESTED if there is no cache file, no Adj Close column, fewer than 20 days, or Close equals Adj Close everywhere (max |Adj/Close - 1| <= 1e-4). Else share_unadj = share of days with |build/Close - 1| <= 0.1 percent; reads NOT ADJUSTED if share_unadj >= 0.80; reads ADJUSTED if share_unadj < 0.50 AND corr(ln build/Close, ln Adj/Close) >= 0.90; otherwise counted UNTESTED (undecided). The same rule is the control on the substituted securities.

reach.definition: For the 72 fund series that read adjusted: priced holding account-days = (account, date, security) rows with a value whose close date is before the security's last distribution (the later of the custodian's last dv/dvlt/dvst/dvr row and the last Yahoo-cache Adj/Close step); measured account-days = distinct (account, date) with a non-null daily return that hold at least one such security that day (the per-security sum is 8553); measured_days_on_a_distribution_date = distinct measured (account, date) on which a held adjusted fund has a distribution date (a custodian distribution row date or a Yahoo-cache Adj/Close step date; 82 summed over securities).
reach.direction: A close that is scaled down by every later distribution makes the return across each distribution date larger than the as-traded return by about the distribution's share of the price (the adjusted close already contains that distribution as a price rise); the cash distribution is also credited as a flow by the chain, so it is counted twice on those days. Direction stated from the shape; no return was recomputed here.

headline: In a table of 270 fund series (Mutual Fund and Mutual Fund (Closed End)), 72 read DIVIDEND_ADJUSTED out of 73 tested, with 124 untested (and 73 were substituted with the as-traded close, all 73 of those reading not adjusted); all nine scanned series read adjusted, with an adjustment 1.0 to 2.3 times the single dividend adjustment their distributions imply, so no constant or single factor undoes it.
not_established: Why the store's adjustment is larger than Yahoo's own Adj Close for these series (slope of ln(build/Close) on ln(Adj/Close): median 1.85 over the 72, range 1.0 to 4.2; CPXIX is a single adjustment at 1.02): the store's write history and its vintages were not read; no vendor was asked.

The reading rests on shape (daily steps on distributions, correlation with the implied factor), not on the 80-percent-within-2-percent amplitude test, which all nine FAIL (0 to 2 of 4 to 18 pairs): the observed adjustment is larger than the single adjustment the distributions imply for 8 of 9 (slope 1.64 to 2.27 on the pairs), equal for CPXIX (1.01).

124 fund series are untested: 120 have no Yahoo cache file, 1 has a cache marker with no bars, 2 have Close equal to Adj Close everywhere, 1 (EGFIX, ratio down to 0.135) is undecided by the rule; 119 of the 124 untested are on the custodian-holdings store only, whose close is not a Yahoo series. Their round-70 pair classes: AGREES 4, TOO_FEW 18, no pairs 102; none has a shaped pair series, but that is not the cache test and no count of not adjusted is claimed for them.

The cache is one pull (files dated 2026-10-09; bars 2020-06-29 to 2026-10-08) whose Adj Close is the current vintage; the last 3 to 20 percent of the tested days (to 2026-06-09) equal Close and are not adjusted. The price-store cache that labels each day's source ends 2026-06-09, so build rows after it (to 2026-10-06 for WGIFX, where a spot read gives build/Close 1.000) are outside the test.

ETF and Equity: 2 and 7 series read adjusted at the 0.1 percent tolerance, but every one departs from the cached Close by at most 1 percent (Equity min ratio range [0.994, 0.998]; ETF [0.992, 0.998]): immaterial in size, not sized here. 12 substituted ETF and 6 substituted Equity series were undecided by the rule (split mismatches against the cache, e.g. NVDA, GOOG); none read adjusted.
Fixed Income (184 securities), Cash Equivalent (54), Cash (3) and Alternative Investment (1) in the table were not tested; kinds are the transactions' Asset_Type.

No correction is sized and no return is recomputed; the direction of the return error across a distribution date is stated from the shape. 'Last distribution' for the reach is the later of the custodian's last row and the last Yahoo-cache step; the account-days whose close departs from the cached Close by over 0.1 percent are given beside it.

A distribution date for the reach counts both conventions (custodian row date, Yahoo step date); the ex-date convention of the store's own steps was not read. HLMEX reads adjusted with a ratio down to 0.03 and slope 4.2: unexplained, counted as read.
The three round-70 CONSTANT_SCALE fund series (AMBFX, BALCX, OIEJX) read adjusted here: their constant-scale reading rested on few pairs and is not re-graded here.
